description: Editable reference input families for resource-suitability scoring, not quantified engineering BOMs. Parts receive equal weight by default; constituents share their part's weight. Unknown or omitted formulations are listed explicitly.
reference_basis: Each element's best mean indexed content in kg per tonne of ore; fixed across products and Monte Carlo draws. This is a relative composition benchmark, not a product's mass demand or a measured extraction yield.
